title: Career Roadmap · X-Ray Technician
summary: An X-Ray Technician operates radiographic equipment within their authorised scope, positions patients, produces diagnostic images and follows radiation-safety and infection-control procedures under applicable clinical protocols.

facts.Course: Diploma - Medical Lab Technology (DMLT) / Radiology / Optometry

about.label: Education
about.text: Recognised Diploma in Radiology / Medical Imaging Technology or an eligible related qualification

blocks.label: Recommended stream
blocks.text: Science with Physics, Chemistry and Biology is commonly relevant; exact eligibility varies by programme.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Physics, biology, anatomy, radiation principles and patient care.

blocks.label: Admissions
blocks.text: Requirements and entrance processes vary by institution; verify the current official notification.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Human anatomy, medical imaging, patient positioning and radiation protection.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Attention to detail, communication, safe working practices and computer literacy.

items.text: Diploma in Radiography / Medical Imaging Technology → Entry-level radiography roles, subject to recognition and employer requirements.
B.Sc. Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (MRIT) / Radiography → Broader imaging education and career progression.
DMLT → Laboratory-focused roles; it is not automatically equivalent to a radiography qualification.
B.Sc. Radiotherapy Technology → Radiation-treatment support, a separate pathway from diagnostic X-ray imaging.

blocks.text: Admission eligibility, course duration, clinical placements and professional requirements differ. Confirm recognition before enrolling.
